name_en: Miyazaki hiyajiru — grilled fish and miso ground together, chilled, and poured over barley rice
summary_ja: 焼いた魚と味噌をすり鉢でまぜ合わせ、香ばしく炙ってから出汁でのばして冷やす宮崎の即席汁。夏の農作業の合間に手早く栄養を摂る知恵として広まったとされ、麦飯にかけてきゅうりを添えていただく。
summary_en: Grilled fish is ground together with miso, toasted fragrant over charcoal, then thinned with dashi and chilled — an instant Miyazaki soup said to have spread as a quick way to eat well during heavy summer farm work, poured over barley rice and topped with sliced cucumber.
source_title: 冷や汁 宮崎県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Zabu-jiru — root vegetables simmered together in a soy-seasoned soup
summary_ja: 人参、ごぼう、じゃがいも、大根、かぼちゃなどを炒めていりこと昆布の出汁で煮る都農町の汁物。野菜を「ざぶざぶ」煮ることが名の由来とされ、手に入りやすい根菜でつくる宮崎の日常の家庭料理。
summary_en: Carrot, burdock, potato, daikon, and pumpkin are stir-fried, then simmered in a dashi of dried sardine and kelp — a Tsuno town soup named for the zabu-zabu sound of vegetables boiling away, built from whatever root vegetables are on hand, an everyday dish in Miyazaki homes.
source_title: ざぶ汁 宮崎県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_ja: れんこんのすり流し汁
name_en: Renkon surinagashi-jiru — grated lotus root thickening a miso soup
summary_ja: 水沼神社の池でとれる糸引きれんこんをすりおろし、油揚げと共に出汁と味噌でのばす新富町の汁物。江戸期に高鍋藩主が大和かられんこんを取り寄せたのが始まりと伝わり、真冬に泥田で掘り出す重労働の恵み。
summary_en: Lotus root known for its sticky, thread-drawing texture, grown in the pond by Minuma Shrine, is grated into a miso soup with fried tofu — a Shintomi town dish said to trace back to a feudal lord who brought lotus root in from Yamato in the Edo period, the fruit of a hard midwinter harvest dug from frozen mud.
source_title: れんこんのすり流し汁／れんこんのごりごり汁 宮崎県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Su no shui — grated daikon and sardine simmered in a hot vinegar-soy broth
summary_ja: おろした大根とイワシを酢と醤油で煮る宮崎県西地方の温かい汁物。「しゅい」は方言で汁のことを指し、体を温める冬の料理として餅つきの際にも食べられてきた、都城の在来大根を活かす一品。
summary_en: Grated daikon and sardine are simmered together in a broth of vinegar and soy sauce — a warm winter soup from western Miyazaki, its name using the local dialect word for broth, traditionally served alongside mochi-pounding and built on a daikon variety native to Miyakonojo.
source_title: 酢のしゅい 宮崎県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Kanimaki-jiru — mitten crab ground fine and folded into a miso broth
summary_ja: 生きた山太郎ガニ（モクズガニ）を甲羅ごとすりつぶし、水と味噌を加えて漉した汁を弱火にかける日南市北郷町の秋の汁物。加熱するとタンパク質がおぼろ豆腐のように固まり、カニの旨味を余さず味わえる。
summary_en: A live yamataro crab — a mitten crab known locally by this name — is ground shell and all, mixed with water and miso, strained, then simmered gently — an autumn soup from the Kitago area of Nichinan City, the protein setting into soft curds like silken tofu as it heats, capturing every bit of the crab's flavor.
source_title: かに巻き汁 宮崎県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
